text: ぜんぶ　おれに　まかせれば　いーんだって！

structure.jp: ぜんぶ　おれに　まかせれば
structure.en: if you leave it all to me

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば after a verb means 'if you do it'. まかせれば = 'if you leave it'.

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ explains or insists on something. って at the end repeats what you said, 'I'm telling you'. いーんだって = 'I'm telling you it's fine'.
